what: Cards (item) are scattered over an endless dot-pattern board in a jittered grid — every 308×412 cell has a fixed random position (±8% of the cell), column stagger (.85 cell), size (.72~1.08) and tilt (±6°), so it looks the same on return. Dragging follows the hand (needs more than 3px to count as a drag, and the click after a drag is blocked). On release it glides at that speed, cooling by .92 per frame. The wheel pans the board by that amount with no inertia, and ctrl(⌘)+wheel zooms .6~2x around the cursor position. When the cursor is in the outer half toward a screen edge, the board flows that way (strength is the square of the distance toward the edge, ramping up and down by .09 per frame, so it keeps flowing about 1 second after the cursor leaves), and the whole board shifts opposite the cursor up to 40px as parallax. On first show it appears from .965x and transparent over .7s expo.out.

options.drift: Vertical stagger per column (times cell height), default .85
options.friction: Speed left per frame after release, default .92
options.zoom-min · zoom-max · zoom-speed: Zoom range and wheel speed, default .6 · 2 · .0016
options.edge · edge-dead: Edge flow strength · resting center share, default 13 · .5
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Source card to scatter (clone it to use — the original is hidden)
options.[data-fx-part=zoom]: (if present, data-dir=in|out) on press scales to 1.25x·.8x over .5s expo.out

use: Card…
note: When the panel covers the whole screen the page can’t scroll, so like the original that page is used as a single panel (on phones dragging is the panel’s whole job, hence touch-action: none). The original’s switch to a horizontal band (slider) type was not carried over
